valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS (the earnings an investor is pricing at the Nov-2027 target date) x justified P/E. FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint $18.10 (range $17.90-$18.30) grown by an assumed 2027 rate; management says 'strong double-digit' 2027 adjusted EPS growth. Listing is the US common share (USD), no ADR conversion. Share count held roughly flat (about 152-153M diluted).

bear.driver: 2027 adjusted EPS growth slows to about 7% as supply-chain/labor limits and acquisition digestion cap conversion of the $63.7B backlog; 765kV work slips

base.driver: About 17% adjusted EPS growth in 2027 on record backlog and 2026 guide raise (revenue $41.3-41.6B)

bull.driver: About 27% EPS growth as 765kV transmission and data-center work enter backlog and margins expand

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $21.20 the $559.03 close implies 26.4x (30.9x the 2026 guide midpoint). The 3 named targets are stale and horizon-undocumented; the Yahoo Finance aggregate mean of $769.78 (30 analysts) implies 36.3x on base EPS, or EPS about $27.50 at 28x (about 30% above the model).
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $21.20 (3.8 pp of the close). $1 of 2027 EPS moves it by $28.
valuation.watch_metric: Total backlog (record $63.7B at Q3 2026) and adjusted EPS guidance for 2027, especially whether 765kV transmission projects convert into backlog
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4/FY2026 results and 2027 guidance, expected around late February 2027 (date not confirmed)

analyst_notes: Only three named analysts with dated calls could be sourced (Bernstein upgrade to Outperform at $775 on 2026-09-24, Citi $733 on 2026-04-27, Truist $643 on 2026-02-20); all predate the 2026-10-29 earnings release, so none reflect the Q3 beat and guide raise. Aggregator snippets suggest post-Q3 raises (e.g. Truist, TD Cowen, Jefferies, Citi at roughly $830-960) but dates, authors and values could not be verified, so they are excluded. Targets have no documented 12-month horizon so they stay out of the weighted target; the published aggregate (mean $769.78) sits well above the model, which needs either about 36x on base EPS or about $27.50 of 2027 EPS.
